description: Registry of known x402-adjacent platform payout wallets with per-entry provenance. Proposed in x402-foundation/x402#3226 round 4 (Circadian-agent, comment 5374882218): a third party who recognises a payer can reclassify an inflow automatically, making the bounty-sink false-positive class detectable by anyone rather than only by the wallet's owner. Every row carries provenance because identifying a platform wallet is itself an inference unless the platform confirms it.

provenance_tiers.tx_hash_confirmed: A public platform record names a transaction whose on-chain sender is the wallet; verified first-hand from chain data before entry. Strongest tier.
provenance_tiers.amount_timestamp_join: Public platform event with amount+timestamp joins a chain transfer within seconds; no tx hash published. Weaker tier.
provenance_tiers.seller_ledger_inference: Payments arrived from one address at plausible times for awards the seller knows they won; seller-asserted, chain-corroborated only in aggregate.

evidence.source: x402-foundation/x402#3226 comment 5375274665 (Circadian-agent, 2026-08-21T20:51Z): completed-award record publishes settlementTxHash 0xa508ae33ee84d53bdbbe49b6d982edfa86273fa6b6d6d479d42aaa9ad035d966
evidence.verification: Receipt re-read first-hand 2026-08-21T21:1xZ via public Base RPC: status 0x1, block 50205488, 11 USDC transfers from this single sender = ten x 0.092500 worker payments + one x 0.075000 platform fee, matching the published award split to the unit.

evidence.source: x402-foundation/x402#3226 comment 5374882218 (Circadian-agent, 2026-08-21T20:18Z): Frantic bounty records publish no addresses and no hashes, only an amount-and-timestamp PAID event; block 50236577 landed 3 seconds after the bounty-115 PAID instant
evidence.verification: Block 50236577 re-read first-hand 2026-08-21T21:1xZ via public Base RPC: exactly one 8.000000 USDC transfer in the block, sender = this wallet, recipient = the Circadian seller wallet (tx 0x64cbf9e80d4cf37f9aabd56f7d0e404e25ded56fd26cb1713bb281fff716db6c).
evidence.honest_limit: Amount+timestamp correlation is weaker than a published tx hash; per-entry provenance exists precisely so users can weight rows differently.

usage: scripts/x402_bazaar_demand_probe.py loads this file (path relative to the script: ../fixtures/ in-repo, ./fixtures/ flat) and labels recognized payers in scan/never output. A wallet NOT in this registry stays unattributed - absence of a label is not evidence of absence.
